profile.overview: Ink / Altruism is Vox Mana's RGWU/non-Black expression for protected public abundance, open knowledge, community benefit, shared resources guarded from capture, and generosity protected from private enclosure.
profile.philosophy: Ink wants resources, knowledge, and care to circulate through a defended commons rather than become private leverage; Red keeps care present, Green keeps reciprocity alive, White gives public promise, and Blue opens knowledge without letting Black-style private hoarding define the center.
profile.core_tension: Ink keeps the gift moving through protected public abundance, but generosity can become self-erasure when private need, guarded consent, or personal limits are treated as selfish by default.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Missing-Black four-color pressure, protected public abundance, open knowledge, shared resources, reciprocity, group-hug/table-politics support texture, and guarded commons play can express Ink only when they serve the full RGWU/non-Black worldview of Red care, Green reciprocity, White civic promise, and Blue open knowledge without Black-style private hoarding; group-hug, public archives, Kynaios, Ink-Treader, Altruism, or same-color identity alone do not define the identity.
